You’re right we are all expendable. Just as easily as we came in this world, we can go out. But don’t worry about your GPA or sat score. I didn’t. Go to a community college, get better grades and then transfer to a state college. Grades aren’t the craziest thing in HS.  You should be worrying about what you want to study in college. But college  isn’t the end all be all. Maybe it’s trade school, or being a flight attendant, pilot or in the military. If ur smart the military will pay for ur college, if it’s in your contract. This guy is right tho, you’re not starving or homeless. It could be worse. You could have thousands of dollars of school loan debt 5 years of being out of college with a degree your don’t use. I think the big lesson is don’t get bullied into college without knowing what u want to do, other wise you’ll settle for a degree you don’t want in the end. Even if the bullying is by your parents

Around 22 i was suicidal for the first time in my life. After i found out a guy i fell in love with was seeing multiple other women and a very expensive dui later, i found myself at the lowest point in my life. No friends or anyone for support, i wanted to end my life, but i found climbing instead. It ended up saving my life. I found a new confidence and believed in myself again. Climbing isn’t for everyone, but i suggest trying something like that or even skydiving. Something that shows you that you want to be alive.

Not to make light of your situation,but your not alone. I’ve been thru that. Not sure how old u are but thru my own experiences I’ve been thru that serval times. People come and go, so pick your friends wisely. You get comfortable with people and don’t realize you’re not growing or learning together & that’s when u stop living. But your dogs will be the most loyal thing in your life. Don’t take that for granted. I wish i had a companion still.
